Download the file named for your system. On a Mac, take the one ending in `-mac.dmg`. On Windows, take `-windows-setup.exe`. On Linux, take the `.deb` for Ubuntu, Debian or Linux Mint, the `.rpm` for Fedora or openSUSE, or the `.AppImage` for anything else.

The first time you open Pageroom, your computer warns that the app isn't signed. The [README](https://github.com/myrheimb/pageroom#download) shows how to open it anyway. You only need `SHA256SUMS` to check that a download is intact.
